<p class="owner"><span class="en">Owner: Kai</span><span class="zh">负责人：马凯</span></p>

::: {.en}
A waste-to-energy plant in the Latrobe Valley, modelled year by year from 2027. The model chains four steps: **the licence** limits how many furnaces we can build; **our gate fee** decides how much waste councils and businesses will send us; **that waste**, spread across the furnaces, sets how full the plant runs; and **how full it runs** against fixed costs per furnace decides whether it pays back. Market share is a result, not an input. All money is nominal A\$, excluding GST. The results bar at the bottom of the screen updates as you move any control.
:::

::: {.zh}
拉筹伯谷（Latrobe Valley）垃圾焚烧发电厂，自2027年起逐年测算。模型由四步串联：**许可配额**决定可建焚烧炉数量；**我方处理费**决定市政和企业愿意送来的垃圾量；**垃圾量**在各焚烧炉间平均分配，决定工厂负荷率；**负荷率**与每台炉的固定成本共同决定能否回本。市场份额是结果而非输入。所有金额为名义澳元，不含GST。屏幕底部的结果栏会随任何参数变化而实时更新。
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Use the locally bundled libraries instead of Observable's CDN defaults
Inputs = window.Inputs
Plot = window.Plot
d3 = window.d3
html = window.htl.html
// Label that switches with the language button (CSS shows one span)
L = (en, zh) => html`<span class="en">${en}</span><span class="zh">${zh}</span>`
lang = Generators.observe(notify => {
  const f = () => notify(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-lang") || "en");
  f();
  const mo = new MutationObserver(f);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-lang"]});
  return () => mo.disconnect();
})
T = (en, zh) => lang === "zh" ? zh : en
csv = path => fetch(path).then(r => r.text()).then(t => d3.csvParse(t, d3.autoType))
wasteHist = csv("../data/vic_waste_history.csv")
levyHist = csv("../data/levy_history.csv")
scen = csv("../data/scenarios.csv")
councilsRaw = csv("../data/councils.csv")
// Safe defaults in case data/councils.csv is older than this page
councils = councilsRaw.map(c => ({...c, cv_mj_kg: Number.isFinite(c.cv_mj_kg) ? c.cv_mj_kg : 10.9, rail_only: c.rail_only ?? 0, port_km: c.port_km ?? null, sea_km: c.sea_km ?? null}))
comps = csv("../data/waste_components.csv")
compData = csv("../data/vic_waste_components.csv")
C = ({hist: "#52514e", base: "#2a78d6", low: "#eb6834", high: "#1baf7a", grey: "#9a9890"})
fmtM = v => (v / 1e6).toFixed(0)
kt = v => (v / 1e3).toFixed(0)
// Paragraph from our own trusted strings that contain <b> tags
rich = s => { const p = document.createElement("p"); p.className = "kpi-note"; p.innerHTML = s; return p; }
startYear = 2027
opYears = 25
```

## [1 · Market: licence and feedstock]{.en}[1 · 市场：许可配额与原料]{.zh}

::: {.en}
Victoria caps waste-to-energy at **2.5 Mt a year**. In August 2025 seven licences took 2.35 Mt of it (Cleanaway 760 kt, HiQ 750 kt, Melbourne Water 450 kt, Recovered Energy 280 kt and three small ones), which leaves about 150 kt unallocated. A new entrant therefore needs either a partner that already holds a licence or a higher cap. The government said in February 2026 that it does not support an increase, so the cap slider is the "what if it is lifted" case.
:::

::: {.zh}
维州垃圾焚烧发电总量上限为**每年250万吨**。2025年8月已发放7张许可，共235万吨（Cleanaway 76万吨、HiQ 75万吨、Melbourne Water 45万吨、Recovered Energy 28万吨及三家小型企业），未分配余量约15万吨。因此新进入者要么与现有许可持有方合作，要么需要上限提高。政府于2026年2月表示不支持提高上限，故上限滑块代表“若上限提高”的情景。
:::

::: {.column width="40%"}

```{ojs}
// Option labels avoid T() so switching language does not rebuild (and reset) the controls
```


<p class="figure-note"><span class="en"><b>This is the furnace's feedstock, not the whole market.</b> In 2023–24 Victoria generated about 14.2 Mt of waste: 9.9 Mt was recovered (mostly rubble, metals and organics) and 4.3 Mt went to landfill. Of that, 1.0 Mt was construction rubble and 3.3 Mt was household and commercial waste, and about 2.5 Mt of the 3.3 Mt is material that can burn. Burnable household and commercial waste landfilled in Victoria, by material, 2015–16 to 2024–25 (solid), with projections (faded). Energy content uses typical as-discarded values per material (food 4.7, garden 6.5, biosolids 2.0, paper 16.5, textiles 18, timber 18.6, plastics 32.6 MJ/kg). Sources: DCCEEW NWRR 2026; Tchobanoglous, Theisen & Vigil, <i>Integrated Solid Waste Management</i> (1993), Table 4-16.</span><span class="zh"><b>此图为焚烧原料，而非整个市场。</b>2023–24年度维州共产生约1420万吨垃圾：990万吨被回收（主要为建筑废料、金属和有机物），430万吨填埋；其中100万吨为建筑废料，330万吨为生活及工商业垃圾，其中约250万吨为可燃物。维州填埋的可燃生活及工商业垃圾（按成分），2015–16至2024–25年度（实色）及预测（浅色）。热值采用各成分典型丢弃状态值（厨余4.7、园林6.5、污泥2.0、纸16.5、纺织18、木材18.6、塑料32.6兆焦/千克）。来源：国家废物数据库2026；Tchobanoglous等《Integrated Solid Waste Management》(1993) 表4-16。</span></p>


## [2 · Price: who will send us their waste]{.en}[2 · 价格：谁会把垃圾交给我们]{.zh}

::: {.en}
A customer only switches if our gate fee **plus transport** to the Latrobe Valley is cheaper than its landfill bill (gate fee + levy) by a margin worth the hassle of re-tendering a contract. There is no published figure for this threshold; 10% is a reasonable default, since council waste tenders are rarely re-run for savings smaller than that. Councils are modelled one by one (see the [council price map](council-map.qmd)). Commercial waste is modelled as Melbourne-based customers whose landfill prices vary ±25% around the metro price.
:::

::: {.zh}
只有当我方处理费**加上运至拉筹伯谷的运费**比客户的填埋成本（处理费+填埋税）低出足够幅度、值得重新招标时，客户才会转换。该门槛没有公开数据；默认取10%较为合理，因为市政通常不会为更小的节省重新招标。市政逐一测算（见[市政价格地图](council-map.qmd)）；工商业垃圾按墨尔本客户计算，其填埋价格在大都市价格±25%范围内分布。
:::

:::: {.columns .model-row}
::: {.column width="40%"}
```{ojs}

viewof levyScen = Inputs.radio(["base", "low", "high"], {value: "base", label: L("Levy trend", "填埋税趋势"),
  format: k => ({base: L("Base +5%/yr", "基准 每年+5%"), low: L("Low +2.5%/yr", "低 每年+2.5%"), high: L("High +10%/yr", "高 每年+10%")})[k]})
viewof lfGate = Inputs.range([40, 160], {value: 95, step: 5, label: L("Metro landfill gate fee excl. levy", "大都市填埋处理费（不含税）")})
```

```{ojs}
  ]
})
```

<p class="figure-note"><span class="en">Raise the fee and customers drop away. The plant burns the lowest of three lines: what customers send (shaded), furnace capacity (black) and the licence (orange).</span><span class="zh">处理费越高，客户越少。工厂实际处理量取三者最小值：客户愿送量（阴影）、焚烧炉产能（黑线）和许可配额（橙线）。</span></p>

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
rememberFurnaces = { window.__lastFurnaces = furnaces; return furnaces; }
// ---------- Model ----------
// Feedstock by material: each material follows its own 2020-25 trend, shifted by the scenario
scenAdj = ({base: 0, low: -0.02, high: 0.02})
cvOf = Object.fromEntries(comps.map(d => [d.component, d.mj_per_kg]))
trendOf = Object.fromEntries(comps.map(d => [d.component, d.base_trend]))
compHist = compData
base2025 = Object.fromEntries(compData.filter(d => d.year === 2025).map(d => [d.component, d.mt]))
compProj = ["base", "low", "high"].flatMap(sc => d3.range(2025, 2056).flatMap(y => comps.map(c => ({scenario: sc, year: y, component: c.component,
  mt: base2025[c.component] * Math.pow(1 + Math.max(-0.15, trendOf[c.component] + scenAdj[sc]), y - 2025)}))))
totals = {
  const rows = [...compHist, ...compProj.filter(d => d.scenario === wasteScen && d.year > 2025)];
  return d3.groups(rows, d => d.year).map(([year, list]) => {
    const o = {year}; let mt = 0, pj = 0;
    for (const d of list) { o[d.component] = d.mt; mt += d.mt; pj += d.mt * cvOf[d.component]; }
    return Object.assign(o, {mt, pj, cv: pj / mt});
  }).sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
}
totalBy = new Map(totals.map(d => [d.year, d]))
wasteBaseYear = 2025
wasteBase = totalBy.get(2025).mt
wasteScale = y => totalBy.get(Math.min(y, 2055)).mt / wasteBase
// Electricity per tonne delivered follows the energy content of that year's waste
cvTrend = y => totalBy.get(Math.min(y, 2055)).cv / totalBy.get(2025).cv
// Energy content of what we actually receive: each council's own red-bin value plus commercial waste
mixCV = (s, y) => s.total ? (s.kerbMJ * cvTrend(y) + s.ci * totalBy.get(Math.min(y, 2055)).cv * (1 - nonComb)) / s.total : 0
kwhPerMJ = effElec / 3.6 * 1000
levyRate = Object.fromEntries(scen.filter(d => d.driver === "levy").map(d => [d.scenario, d.annual_change]))
levy2027 = Object.fromEntries(levyHist.filter(d => d.year === 2027).map(d => [d.zone, d.levy]))
levy0 = levy2027.VIC_METRO
levyAt = (s, y) => levy0 * Math.pow(1 + levyRate[s], Math.max(0, y - startYear))
allocated = 2350000
licence = Math.max(0, capMt * 1e6 - allocated) + partner
perFurnace = tpd * 365 * availability
maxFurnaces = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.floor(licence / perFurnace + 0.15)))
capacity = furnaces * perFurnace
cod = startYear + buildYears
capex = (capexSite + capexFurnace * furnaces) * 1e6
fixedTotal = (fixedFurnace * furnaces + fixedSite) * 1e6
limitName = ({supply: T("customers at this price", "此价格下的客源"), capacity: T("furnace capacity", "焚烧炉产能"), licence: T("the licence", "许可配额")})
// Landfill gate fees excl. levy by zone (2027), matching the council map defaults
gateLF = ({VIC_METRO: lfGate, VIC_RURAL: lfGate + 15, NSW_MLA: lfGate + 25, SA_METRO: lfGate - 5, NSW_NOLEVY: lfGate + 35, SA_NONMETRO: lfGate + 15, ACT: 111})
// Transport to Morwell, 2027 A$/t (cheapest of road and rail), same as the map defaults
// Transport to Morwell, 2027 A$/t: per 20 ft container (cheapest of road, rail, sea), divided by
// tonnes per container from each council's density (same defaults as the council price map)
councilDelivery = new Map(councils.map(c => {
  const tpc = Math.min(24, 33 * Math.max(0.35, Math.min(0.8, 0.60 + 0.05 * (11 - c.cv_mj_kg))));
  const road = c.rail_only ? Infinity : 150 + 3.5 * Math.max(0, c.road_km - 30);
  const rail = c.rail_km ? 400 + 1.4 * c.rail_km + (c.rail_km > 200 ? 150 : 0) : Infinity;
  const sea = c.sea_km ? 150 + 3.5 * c.port_km + 2 * 350 + 1.1 * c.sea_km + (150 + 1.4 * 150 + 100) : Infinity;
  return [c.name, Math.min(road, rail, sea) / tpc];
}))
ciPool2025 = (wasteHist.find(d => d.year === 2025).combustible_landfill_mt - 0.995) * 1e6
// Waste customers would send at gate fee gf (2027 A$) in year y
supplyAt = (gf, y) => {
  const g = Math.pow(1 + inflation, y - startYear), lev = levyAt(levyScen, y), sc = wasteScale(y);
  const fee = gf * g + passThrough * (lev - levy0 * g);
  const levyZ = {VIC_METRO: lev, VIC_RURAL: levy2027.VIC_RURAL * lev / levy0, NSW_MLA: levy2027.NSW_MLA * g, SA_METRO: levy2027.SA_METRO * g, NSW_NOLEVY: 0, SA_NONMETRO: levy2027.SA_NONMETRO * g, ACT: 0};
  let kerb = 0, kerbMJ = 0, n = 0, far = 0;
  for (const c of councils) {
    const landfill = gateLF[c.zone] * g + levyZ[c.zone];
    if (fee + councilDelivery.get(c.name) * g <= landfill * (1 - threshold)) { kerb += c.garbage_t * sc; kerbMJ += c.garbage_t * sc * c.cv_mj_kg; n++; if (c.road_km > 100) far += c.garbage_t * sc; }
  }
  const Lm = lfGate * g + lev, offer = (fee + 34 * g) / (1 - threshold);
  const ciFrac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (1.25 * Lm - offer) / (0.5 * Lm)));
  const ci = ciPool2025 * sc * ciFrac;
  return {kerb, kerbMJ, ci, total: kerb + ci, nCouncils: n, far, fee, landfill: Lm};
}
model = (gf) => {
  const dep = capex / opYears;
  let cum = 0, dcum = 0, lossCF = 0;
  const out = [];
  for (let y = startYear; y < cod + opYears; y++) {
    const t = y - startYear, g = Math.pow(1 + inflation, t), df = Math.pow(1 + discount, -(t + 0.5));
    const row = {year: y, building: y < cod};
    if (row.building) {
      Object.assign(row, {cash: -capex / buildYears, revenue: 0, fixed: 0, variable: 0});
    } else {
      const s = supplyAt(gf, y);
      const tonnes = Math.min(s.total, capacity, licence);
      const limit = tonnes === s.total ? "supply" : tonnes === capacity ? "capacity" : "licence";
      const cv = mixCV(s, y), kwh = cv * kwhPerMJ;
      const revenue = tonnes * s.fee + tonnes * kwh / 1000 * powerPrice * g;
      const fixed = fixedTotal * g;
      const variable = tonnes * (varOpex + sortCost) * g + tonnes * ashShare * s.landfill;
      const ebitda = revenue - fixed - variable;
      let taxable = ebitda - dep - lossCF; lossCF = taxable < 0 ? -taxable : 0;
      const tax = Math.max(0, taxable) * taxRate;
      const share = s.total ? tonnes / s.total : 0;
      Object.assign(row, {tonnes, cv, kwh, kerbT: s.kerb * share, ciT: s.ci * share,
        kerbCV: s.kerb ? s.kerbMJ / s.kerb * cvTrend(y) : 0, ciCV: totalBy.get(Math.min(y, 2055)).cv * (1 - nonComb), supply: s.total, util: tonnes / capacity, limit, fee: s.fee, revenue, fixed, variable,
        stations: Math.ceil(Math.min(s.far, tonnes) / 150000), cash: ebitda - tax});
    }
    cum += row.cash; dcum += row.cash * df;
    Object.assign(row, {cumulative: cum, discounted: dcum, df});
    out.push(row);
  }
  return out;
}
npvOf = r => r.reduce((s, d) => s + d.cash * d.df, 0)
rows = model(gateFee)
ops = rows.filter(d => !d.building)
first = ops[0]
npv = npvOf(rows)
irr = {
  const f = r => rows.reduce((s, d) => s + d.cash * Math.pow(1 + r, -(d.year - startYear + 0.5)), 0);
  let lo = -0.5, hi = 1;
  if (f(lo) * f(hi) > 0) return null;
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; (f(lo) * f(m) <= 0) ? hi = m : lo = m; }
  return (lo + hi) / 2;
}
paybackYear = ops.find(d => d.cumulative >= 0)?.year
marketMt = Math.min(capMt, wasteBase * wasteScale(cod))
```

## [Method and limits]{.en}[方法与局限]{.zh}

::: {.en}
- **Licence** = (cap − 2.35 Mt already allocated) + the partner's licence. The number of furnaces is limited to what the licence can fill (at most 5).
- **Tonnes burned** each year = the lowest of: what customers would send at our price, furnace capacity, and the licence. Tonnes are shared equally across furnaces.
- **Energy of the mix we burn**: each council we win brings its own red-bin energy content (9.6–12.4 MJ/kg, see the [council price map](council-map.qmd)); commercial waste carries the burnable-mix value from section 1, less the non-burnable share. The mix sets electricity per tonne (MJ/kg × efficiency ÷ 3.6), and moves over time with the materials trend.
- **Customer switching**: a council switches if our gate fee plus transport is at least the chosen margin below its landfill cost (zone gate fee plus levy, rising with the levy scenario). Commercial customers are 1.42 Mt of burnable C&I waste, assumed to be in Melbourne (about 150 km by road, A\$34/t) with landfill prices spread ±25% around the metro price. Other licence holders compete for the same waste; that competition is not modelled.
- **Costs**: fixed cost per furnace (staff, maintenance, insurance) plus site overhead are paid regardless of load, so a half-empty plant loses money on every tonne it doesn't burn. Variable costs (reagents, consumables) and pre-sorting scale with tonnes. Ash goes to landfill at the metro landfill price.
- **Default costs are benchmarks to adjust**, set so that a three-furnace plant at full load costs about A\$1.85k per tonne of annual capacity and about A\$75/t to run, in line with Kwinana and Maryvale.
- **Not modelled**: debt, LGC certificate revenue, metals recovery and transfer-station capex.
:::

::: {.zh}
- **许可配额** =（上限 − 已分配235万吨）+ 合作方许可。焚烧炉数量受许可可支持的规模限制（最多5台）。
- **年处理量**取三者最小值：此价格下客户愿送量、焚烧炉产能、许可配额；处理量在各炉间平均分配。
- **混合垃圾热值**：每个争取到的市政按其红桶垃圾热值计入（9.6–12.4兆焦/千克，见[市政价格地图](council-map.qmd)）；工商业垃圾按第1部分可燃混合热值扣除不可燃比例。混合热值决定每吨发电量（兆焦/千克 × 效率 ÷ 3.6），并随成分趋势变化。
- **客户转换**：市政在我方处理费加运费比其填埋成本（税区处理费+填埋税，随情景上涨）低出设定比例时转换。工商业客户为142万吨可燃工商业垃圾，假设位于墨尔本（公路约150公里，34澳元/吨），填埋价格在大都市价格±25%内分布。其他许可持有方也在争夺同一批原料，此竞争未纳入模型。
- **成本**：每台炉的固定成本（人员、维护、保险）及厂区管理费用与负荷无关，因此半空运行的工厂在每一吨未处理的垃圾上都会亏损；变动成本（药剂、耗材）和预分拣成本随处理量变化；灰渣按大都市填埋价格处置。
- **默认成本为可调整的基准**：三炉满负荷时约每年吨产能1850澳元投资、每吨约75澳元运营成本，与Kwinana和Maryvale项目相当。
- **未纳入**：债务、绿证收入、金属回收及转运站投资。
:::
